title: Value of a finite bit prefix
statement: For every bit string $w$ and natural number $n$, the sum of $2^j$ times the bit of $w$ at position $j$ over $0\le j<n$ equals the value of the prefix of $w$ of length $n$, interpreting missing bits as zero.
